team:
[roles.lead]
harness = "pi"
model = "nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017"
instructions = "You read and coordinate: read files with `read`, `grep`, `find` and `ls`, as every command or edit of yours is refused."
auth = "provider"
may_spawn = ["worker"]
approvals = "deny"

[roles.worker]
harness = "openhands"
model = "nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017"
instructions = "Claim a task on the queue `tasks` and do it in this checkout: fix the issue it names, add a test that fails without your fix, and run `python3 -m unittest`. Leave your change uncommitted. Post a note on the board `notes`, named `fix-` and the issue's number, saying what you changed and what the tests said, citing the task. Complete the task citing the note, then finish citing it too."
auth = "provider"
approvals = "allow"

[auth]
provider = { env = ["OPENAI_BASE_URL", "OPENAI_API_KEY"] }

[budget]
turns = 16
wall = "20m"

[topology]
until = "role:lead"
edges = { lead = ["children", "human"], worker = ["parent"] }

[topology.channels.notes]
kind = "board"
writers = "all"
readers = "all"

[topology.channels.tasks]
kind = "queue"
writers = "role:lead"
readers = "role:worker"
lease = "30m"

[topology.limits]
max_hops = 8
